description: Manages user-defined saved filters, allowing users to store and reuse complex search criteria for various entities within the system.

endpoints.name: CreateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Creates a new saved filter based on the provided criteria. This allows users to store and reuse specific search configurations.

request.description: The request body containing the details for the new saved filter, including its name, description, and the filter criteria.

example_uses: Create a new saved filter named 'My Projects in Africa' for the 'Project' entity.
I want to save a filter that shows all 'Partners' with 'Active' status and 'High' risk.
Can you help me create a new saved filter for 'Interactions' that occurred last month?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user wants to permanently store a set of search parameters for future use, avoiding the need to re-enter them repeatedly.

endpoints.name: UpdateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Updates an existing saved filter with new information. This can include changing its name, description, or the underlying filter criteria.

request.description: The request body containing the updated details for the saved filter. The filter is identified by its ID within this request.

example_uses: Update the 'My Projects in Africa' filter to also include projects with 'Pending' status.
I need to rename my 'High Risk Partners' filter to 'Critical Partners'.
Modify the saved filter for 'Interactions' to only show those from the last 7 days.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user needs to modify the details or criteria of an already existing saved filter.

endpoints.name: DeleteSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Deletes a specific saved filter identified by its unique ID. This action is irreversible.

id.description: The unique identifier of the saved filter to be deleted.

example_uses: Delete the saved filter with ID 123.
Remove the 'Old Archived Projects' filter.
Can you delete the filter I created last year that I no longer use?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user wants to permanently remove a saved filter from the system.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Retrieves the details of a specific saved filter by its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the saved filter to retrieve.

example_uses: Get the details of saved filter with ID 456.
Show me the criteria for the 'Active Grants' filter.
What are the parameters stored in the filter named 'My Default View'?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user needs to view the specific configuration or details of a single saved filter.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilters
endpoints.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of saved filters for the current user. This endpoint supports advanced search capabilities through the 'advancedSearch' query parameter, allowing complex filtering of the saved filters themselves. The 'advancedSearch' parameter expects a JSON array of criteria, where each criterion is an object with 'field', 'operator', and 'value'.

Example advancedSearch criteria:
```json
[
  {"field": "name", "operator": "contains", "value": "Project"},
  {"field": "entityType", "operator": "is", "value": "Project"},
  {"field": "isPublic", "operator": "is", "value": true},
  {"field": "createdDate", "operator": "between", "value": ["2023-01-01", "2023-12-31"]}
]
```

Available operators include: 'like', 'is', 'not', 'contains', 'startsWith', 'between'.
Common fields for filtering saved filters include: 'name', 'description', 'entityType', 'isPublic', 'createdBy', 'createdDate', 'lastModifiedDate'.

request.description: An object containing search and pagination parameters. This can include 'pageIndex', 'pageSize', 'sortBy', 'sortOrder', and 'advancedSearch' for complex filtering.

example_uses: List all saved filters I have created.
Show me all saved filters related to 'Partners', paginated with 10 items per page.
Find all public saved filters that were created in the last month and contain 'Report' in their name.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user wants to browse, search, or filter their collection of saved filters, or retrieve a list of all available saved filters.

endpoints.name: ApplySavedFilter
endpoints.description: Applies a specific saved filter by its ID and returns the configured filter request object. This allows the client to dynamically construct a search query based on the saved filter's criteria, optionally overriding pagination parameters.

id.description: The unique identifier of the saved filter to apply.

pageIndex.description: Optional page index to override the one stored in the saved filter (default: 1).

pageSize.description: Optional page size to override the one stored in the saved filter (default: 10).

example_uses: Apply the saved filter with ID 789 to get its search parameters.
I want to use the 'All Active Projects' filter, but only for the second page of results.
Retrieve the search criteria from my 'Default Partner View' filter.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user wants to retrieve the actual search criteria defined within a saved filter, typically to then execute a search on another entity using those criteria.

endpoints.name: GetFilterStatistics
endpoints.description: Retrieves usage statistics for saved filters, providing insights into their popularity or distribution. Optionally, statistics can be filtered by a specific entity type.

entityType.description: Optional parameter to filter statistics by a specific entity type (e.g., 'Project', 'Partner').

example_uses: Get overall usage statistics for all saved filters.
Show me the statistics for saved filters related to 'Interactions'.
How many saved filters are there for each entity type?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to gain analytical insights into how saved filters are being used across different entities or overall.
